title: Ball Screws, Part 2: Nominal Diameters and Nominal Leads - Metric Series
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 3408 specifies the nominal diameters and nominal leads, metric series, for ball screws. It also gives preferred combinations of nominal diameter and nominal lead and a general plan which includes additional combinations to be used when it becomes necessary to deviate from the preferred combinations.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Ball Screws, Part 1: Vocabulary and Designation

clause_3_terminology: Part 2: Nominal Diameters and Nominal Leads

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
